newsitem.title: UK: Oil lower as U.S. gasoline rally reverses.
newsitem.headline: Oil lower as U.S. gasoline rally reverses.

text.p: Oil prices lost more ground on Monday as a recent fierce rally on gasoline markets in the United States faltered.
International benchmark Brent blend crude lost 15 cents to $18.84 a barrel.
Summer demand for gasoline in the United States and unusually profitable refinery margins prompted by technical mishaps at plants in the U.S. and Europe have buoyed world oil prices in recent weeks.
But a seasonal fall in demand in the West and the resumption of gasoline production at the major Bayway refinery on the U.S. east coast was beginning to offset support from low stocks.
Iraq's exports under the second phase of a UN humanitarian exchange were accelerated on Monday with Baghdad's first shipment since May from the Gulf port of Mina al Bakr.
U.S. trader Coastal was scheduled to take 2.3 million barrels of crude as Iraq bids to lift some 30 million barrels in just three weeks before an interim early September deadline runs out.
The renewed Iraqi crude exports are mostly heading West and are competing with recent sales of crude from German strategic stocks.
